title: I Found the Best Beach in Vietnam
description:
Sao Beach is situated in An Thoi Town, Phu Quoc island district, Kien Giang province, Vietnam. This is one of the most beautiful beaches in Phu Quoc Island with smooth white sand crescent-shaped which is limited by rocky headlands protruding into the sea. Setting foot on Bai Sao Beach, tourists will find ecstatic with the unspoiled beauty of the beach along with white sand stretching, quite clear blue sea water all year round.
